einzeiler: Week 2 fantasy football running back rankings and tier breakdowns
kurzfassung: Chris Welsh, Pat Fitzmaurice, and Andrew Erickson analyze running back rankings and decisions for Week 2 of fantasy football. The discussion covers trust in early-season workloads, matchup impacts, and player evaluations. Specific players analyzed include Kenneth Walker, De’Von Achane, and Bucky Irving.
stichpunkte: Week 1 rankings recap and early-season workload evaluations
Analysis of top-tier running backs ranked 1 through 12
Discussion of Kenneth Walker’s expanded role
Evaluations of De’Von Achane and Bucky Irving
Review of RB2 and flex options ranked 13 through 36
Analysis of deeper running back plays and upside candidates
beschreibung:
Chris Welsh, Pat Fitzmaurice, and Andrew Erickson break down the biggest Week 2 running back ranking decisions, including which early-season workloads you can trust and where matchup concerns should change your expectations.
Kenneth Walker’s expanded role takes center stage, while the guys also debate how much confidence to have in De’Von Achane, Bucky Irving, and several volatile RB2 and flex options.
Plus, they identify a few deeper running backs who could outperform consensus and help fantasy managers navigate difficult Week 2 lineup calls.
